title: Sandor Cseh Handed Two-Game Suspension at the World Aquatics Women’s Water Polo World Cup 2026
text:
5 May 2026, Lausanne - The Aquatics Integrity Unit (AQIU) has issued a two-game suspension to Hungarian head coach Sandor Cseh for protesting referee’s decisions.
The incident occurred during the Group D Match between Hungary and Greece on 4 May 2026, at the World Aquatics Women’s Water Polo World Cup 2026 – Division 1, in Rotterdam, Netherlands.
